# Handoff Acknowledged

## Status Summary

| Metric | Champion | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|----------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.904** | 1.762 |
| Tuning Min | **0.431** | 0.051 |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.793 | **1.793** |
| Lockbox Min | 1.134 | **1.347** |
| Worst MDD | **-9.31%** | -11.18% |

## Analysis

**Champion retains crown** — The `champion_v5_latest` maintains better risk-adjusted performance:
- Higher tuning mean/min (more consistent across folds)
- Tighter worst-case drawdown (-9.3% vs -11.2%)

**Last PASS candidate** (`exp_macro_alpha_shadow`) shows:
- ✅ Slightly better lockbox minimum (more robust on holdout)
- ⚠️ Much worse tuning minimum (0.05 vs 0.43) — indicates potential fold instability
- ⚠️ Worse drawdown profile

## Recommended Next Steps

Execute the provided commands in sequence:

```bash
# 1. Run AUB autopilot - select best from registry
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best

# 2. Run system-level candidates
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run

# 3. Generate next fix report
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

## Watch Items
- Monitor fold stability (tuning_min should stay >0.3)
- MDD threshold appears to be ~-10%; candidates exceeding this may need risk adjustments

Ready to proceed or review specific metrics?
